description: This file contains the implementation of the PaymentMethod class within the Opencart API for sale-related payment method management. It defines two main methods: 'index' for retrieving available payment methods and 'save' for saving the selected payment method, handling validation and responses accordingly.

classes.name: PaymentMethod
classes.description: Controller class handling the API endpoints for sale payment methods, including retrieving available methods and saving selected payment method.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve available payment methods based on current session data, performing validation on cart contents and session data, and returning the methods as JSON.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save the selected payment method. It validates input, updates session data, and returns JSON response indicating success or errors.
